summary: Iteration 3 testing — Wishlist, Hotel Photo Uploads (with local FS fallback), and AI Concierge (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations). Backend: 59/59 pytest cases pass (36 iter1+iter2 regression + 23 new iter3). Frontend: end-to-end validated via cookie-injected session — unauth heart click shows 'Sign in to save' toast, authed Navbar shows 'Wishlist' link, heart toggles state and orange fill on /hotels, /wishlist renders hotel-card-htl_01 after saving, HotelDetail /hotels/htl_01 photo-wall-section accepts a PNG upload (paid booking seeded) and a new photo-tile-* appears immediately, /destinations/goa concierge-section shows 3 pulse skeletons while loading then a Trip Vibe summary + Day 1 + Day 2 cards with Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Insider Tip fields (screenshot captured).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1021 lines — please split into modules (routers/inventory.py, routers/bookings.py, routers/wishlist.py, routers/photos.py, routers/concierge.py, services/email.py, services/storage.py, data/reviews.py). This has been a recurring recommendation across iter2 and iter3 and is now a real maintenance concern.

GET /api/hotels/{hotel_id}/photos does not validate hotel_id — returns [] for unknown ids instead of 404. Not strictly wrong, but inconsistent with POST which does 404. Consider adding the hotel-existence check for symmetry.

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES is enforced only after reading the full body into memory (`data = await file.read()` then size check). A malicious client can still send arbitrarily large payloads and consume memory. Consider streaming to a temp file with a hard size cutoff, or setting the ASGI request-body limit.

storage_path uniqueness is uuid4-based (very low collision risk) but there is no per-user rate limit. Consider a simple per-user rate limit on POST /api/hotels/{id}/photos (e.g., 20/hour) to avoid abuse when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY gets storage privileges and cost matters.
Concierge endpoint is public (no auth) and calls a paid LLM — susceptible to abuse. Consider requiring auth or rate-limiting by IP.

Concierge fallback JSON stripping only handles ```json fences; if the LLM ever wraps in <thinking>…</thinking> tags or adds prose after the JSON, the 'find first {...} block' logic will grab something malformed. Consider a stricter regex or a JSON-only response format (Anthropic supports response_format hints).

Local storage fallback writes files to /app/backend/uploads which is inside the deployed backend directory. Fine for demo, but on redeploy those files vanish. Also `.ctype` sidecar files pollute the same folder — consider a dedicated metadata dir or a Mongo `content_type` field (already stored, so the sidecar file could be removed to keep the tree clean).

The wishlist endpoint sorts hotels client-side by insertion order after Mongo fetch — fine for small counts, but Mongo already returns rows sorted desc. Just build `hotels` in the same order without re-sorting.

get_current_user compares expires_at as ISO string; if the string was written without timezone info (e.g., via mongosh's `new Date()` outside our code path), the parse+replace logic may not correctly compare. Consider storing as native BSON date.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (unauth heart toast, navbar wishlist link, heart toggle + orange fill, /wishlist hotel-card renders, photo-wall upload → new photo-tile appears, /destinations/goa concierge full flow with skeletons → summary + Day 1 + Day 2 cards containing morning/afternoon/evening/tip)

test_credentials: No external creds. Test user + session_token seeded via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md. Used both as Bearer for backend and session_token cookie for browser.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py session-scoped fixture creates/deletes a TEST_ user + session; iter3 tests additionally seed a `paid` booking row per test (both single-hotel and is_bundle variants) and clean up hotel_photos + uploaded_files + wishlists + bookings after each test. Frontend flow used a dedicated 'test-user-fe3-1784134410082' user with a paid htl_01 booking — fully cleaned up after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter3 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_travelo_iter3.py — cover: (a) wishlist toggle + GET + ordering + 401/404, (b) photo upload with paid single/bundle bookings + 401/403/404/400/413/empty guards + /api/files/... serving actual bytes with content-type, (c) concierge live LLM call for goa/jaipur + days clamping to 7 + 404 for unknown destination. Object storage is in LOCAL FILESYSTEM fallback (/app/backend/uploads) because init returns 401 for the current EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — code handles this transparently and file bytes ARE served correctly via /api/files/{path}. Concierge is LIVE Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations and reliably returned valid JSON in every test run (~10-15s per call). Razorpay + Google Places + Resend still in demo/curated/mock mode.
